d: The Trump administration has approved a proposed $24.3 billion sale of 48 F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia, despite concerns raised by US intelligence agencies and members of Congress. The F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia could make the kingdom only the second country in West Asia, after Israel, to operate the advanced stealth fighter. But the deal has triggered concerns over China's access to F-35 technology, given Saudi Arabia's growing military and security ties with Beijing.
